name: freeze-radius-poc
title: Cindra Freeze-Radius PoC (ci-b5i)
author: cindra
description: Standalone spike (ci-b5i, revisits ci-p7z) measuring whether a HIGH HeatInterfacePrototype.heating_radius can thaw freezable machines many tiles away as an AMBIENT emitter on a surface with entities_require_heating=true. Registers a minimal freeze-carrier planet plus a family of heat-interface clones at increasing heating_radius, and a headless factorio-test suite that reads LuaEntity.frozen to map the effective thaw radius, any hidden engine clamp, the warm/nightward split, overshoot, emitter spacing, and perf. Runs on its own scratch surface; touches no other planet.
